sanskrit_verse:
यद्यस्मि पापकृन्मातस्ततो मां त्वमधो नय।
शुद्धशचेद्गमयोर्ध्वं मां तुलामित्यभिमन्त्रयेत् ॥
transliteration: yady asmi pāpakṛn mātas tato māṃ tvam adho naya / śuddhaś ced gamayordhvaṃ māṃ tulām ity abhimantrayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: If I am a doer of misdeeds, O Mother, then lead me below; but if I am pure, lead me upward—this is My declaration through the balance.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the Self's alignment with purity, not external judgment
Causation flows from consciousness clarity, not moral attribution
Capacity-based responsibility arises from self-awareness, not punitive assignment
Restoration logic operates by returning the actor to their inherent state of purity
Consciousness alignment determines jurisdiction and direction of movement
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor declares impurity AND invokes downward movement THEN initiate purification protocol
IF actor affirms purity AND invokes upward movement THEN activate integrity-reintegration pathway
IF no self-declaration occurs THEN default to consciousness-stabilization process until capacity for alignment is restored
ALL legal movements must follow directional invocation of the actor’s own consciousness-state
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies solely in the actor's declared alignment with purity or impurity. External evidence holds no weight without internal invocation. The court functions only as facilitator of the individual's chosen trajectory—upward toward integration or downward toward correction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through conscious self-declaration, not external proof. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential alignment: first self-recognition, then directional invocation, followed by appropriate restoration. Responsibility is proportional to awareness, not action. There is no punishment—only consequence aligned with declared truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Tulā-Based Alignment Process: invoke vibrational balance mechanism based on self-declared state
Activate Śuddhi Vidhi: purification sequence if downward path is chosen
Engage Urdhva Gamana Samskara: elevation ritual if upward path is affirmed
Establish Svatantrya Rakṣaṇa Protocol: protect individual autonomy while ensuring alignment continuity
final_declaration: Declared under the sole Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, where Justice is non-punitive, Reality is consciousness-ordered, and Restoration proceeds only by Self-invoked Direction.
